Mini Wall Golf

A 2D puzzle minigolf game I built in Unity and published on Google Play.

  • Unity
  • C#

Project overview

I implemented the minigolf gameplay for mouse and touch input. The game includes short puzzle courses, a level selection screen and unlockable ball skins.

The current itch.io listing hosts a browser build and an Android APK.

  • Previously published on Google Play
